title: November Examination: Paper 2
instructions: This paper consists of SIX questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Clearly show ALL calculations. Give reasons for all statements in geometry.
You may use an approved scientific calculator unless stated otherwise.
Round off answers to TWO decimal places, unless stated otherwise. Diagrams are not necessarily drawn to scale.

context.text: The number of minutes eight learners spent on homework one evening: $35; 50; 40; 65; 45; 55; 30; 80$

questions.prompt: Calculate the mean.
Calculate the (population) standard deviation, correct to two decimal places.
How many learners spent more than one standard deviation above the mean on homework?
Determine the median and the interquartile range of the data.
Is the data symmetric, positively skewed or negatively skewed? Give a reason.
questions.memo:
✓ Positively skewed (1)
✓ The mean (50) is greater than the median (47,5) (1)

questions.prompt: Identify any outliers in the data using the rule $1{,}5 \times IQR$.
Calculate the length of AB in simplest surd form.
Determine the coordinates of M, the midpoint of AB.
Calculate the gradients of AB and BC, and determine whether AB is perpendicular to BC.
questions.memo:
✓ $m_{AB} = \frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}$ (1)
✓ $m_{BC} = \frac{-6}{-2} = 3$ (1)
✓ $m_{AB} \times m_{BC} = 1 \neq -1$ (1)
✓ So △ABC is NOT right-angled at B (1)

questions.prompt: Determine the equation of the line through C parallel to AB.
Calculate the angle of inclination of BC.
Determine the equation of the perpendicular bisector of AB.
Simplify without a calculator: $\dfrac{\sin(180^\circ - x)\cos(-x)}{\cos(90^\circ + x)\cos(360^\circ - x)}$
Prove the identity: $\dfrac{\sin^2 x}{1 - \cos x} = 1 + \cos x$
questions.memo:
✓ $\sin^2 x = 1 - \cos^2 x$ (1)
✓ $= (1 - \cos x)(1 + \cos x)$ (2)
✓ Cancel to get $1 + \cos x$ (1)

questions.prompt: Determine the general solution of $2\sin x + 1 = 0$.
questions.memo:
✓ $\sin x = -\frac{1}{2}$ (1)
✓ Reference angle $30^\circ$ (1)
✓ $x = 210^\circ + k \cdot 360^\circ$ (1)
✓ or $x = 330^\circ + k \cdot 360^\circ$ (1)
✓ $k \in \mathbb{Z}$ (1)

questions.prompt: Write down the period and amplitude of $f(x) = 3\cos 2x$, and its maximum value.
Solve for $x \in [0^\circ; 360^\circ]$: $2\cos^2 x + \cos x - 1 = 0$

sections.title: QUESTION 4: Sine, cosine and area rules

questions.prompt: Calculate the length of QR, correct to two decimal places.
Calculate the area of △PQR, correct to two decimal places.
Calculate $\hat{Q}$, correct to one decimal place.
O is the centre of a circle. A, B and C lie on the circle and $\hat{AOC} = 140^\circ$, with B on the major arc. Calculate $\hat{ABC}$ and, if D lies on the minor arc AC, $\hat{ADC}$. Give reasons.
questions.memo:
✓ $\hat{ABC} = 70^\circ$ (∠ at centre = 2 × ∠ at circumference) (2)
✓ $\hat{ADC} = 110^\circ$ (opp ∠s of cyclic quad) (1)

questions.prompt: PT is a tangent to the circle at T. TA and TB are chords and $\hat{PTA} = 55^\circ$. B lies in the alternate segment. If $\hat{TAB} = 75^\circ$, find $\hat{TBA}$ and $\hat{ATB}$. Give reasons.
A chord AB of a circle with centre O has length 24 cm. M is the midpoint of AB and OM = 5 cm. Calculate the radius, giving reasons.
questions.memo:
✓ OM ⊥ AB (line from centre to midpt of chord) (1)
✓ AM = 12 cm (1)
✓ $r^2 = 12^2 + 5^2$ (Pythagoras) (1)
✓ $r = 13$ cm (1)

questions.prompt: Two tangents PA and PB are drawn from P to a circle with centre O. If $\hat{AOB} = 120^\circ$, find $\hat{APB}$ and $\hat{PAB}$. Give reasons.
questions.memo:
✓ $\hat{OAP} = \hat{OBP} = 90^\circ$ (tan ⊥ radius) (1)
✓ $\hat{APB} = 60^\circ$ (∠s of quad) (1)
✓ $\hat{PAB} = 60^\circ$ (PA = PB, tans from same pt; ∠s opp = sides) (1)

questions.prompt: In quadrilateral ABCD, $\hat{BAD} = 3x$, $\hat{BCD} = 2x + 30^\circ$ and the exterior angle at C, $\hat{DCE}$, equals $3x$. Find $x$ and prove that ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral.
questions.memo:
✓ $\hat{BCD} + \hat{DCE} = 180^\circ$ (∠s on a str line) (1)
✓ $5x + 30^\circ = 180^\circ$, $x = 30^\circ$ (1)
✓ $\hat{BAD} = 90^\circ$ and $\hat{BCD} = 90^\circ$ (1)
✓ $\hat{BAD} + \hat{BCD} = 180^\circ$ (1)
✓ ABCD is cyclic (converse opp ∠s of cyclic quad) (1)

questions.prompt: A cylindrical water tank has a diameter of 1,4 m and a height of 2 m. Calculate its volume in m³, correct to two decimal places.
A cone has a radius of 7 cm and a slant height of 25 cm. Calculate its perpendicular height and its volume (correct to two decimal places).
If the radius and height of the cone in 6.2 are both doubled, by what factor does the volume increase?
Calculate the surface area of a sphere with radius 10 cm, correct to two decimal places.
A storage container is a cylinder (radius 2 m, height 5 m) with a cone (same radius, perpendicular height 1,5 m) on top. Calculate the total volume, correct to two decimal places.
